intended_application: Drafting outpatient primary-care visit notes from clinician-patient conversation, with clinician review before signing
additional_context: Evidence packet verified 2026-10-24: AMA 2026 Physician AI Survey (Jan 15-Feb 2, 2026; n=1,692 total, self-report; 81% any awareness/use of AI, NOT ambient-scribe prevalence; 88% rate safety/efficacy validation important, 86% privacy assurances): https://www.ama-assn.org/sites/ama-assn.org/files/2026-03/physician-ai-sentiment-report_0.pdf . Vanderbilt primary implementation report, JAMIA 2026, 33(2):457-461: ambient scribing available to over 2,400 ambulatory/ED clinicians on Jan 15, 2025; 1,223 had used it and 20.1% of all visit notes included it by Mar 31, 2025; one academic system, not national prevalence: https://academic.oup.com/jamia/article/33/2/457/8307782 . Afshar et al., NEJM AI, published 2025-11-26: randomized implementation among 66 volunteer clinicians across eight specialties in one health system; 27,092/71,487 notes (38%) used ambient AI; reduced note time by 0.36 h/day; selective sample, not diffusion prevalence: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12858090/ . No representative U.S. ambient-scribe adoption denominator or safety-net primary-care peer rate has been supplied. All organization characteristics here are scenario assumptions, not observed facts.
business_need: Reduce documentation burden without weakening note accuracy or patient trust
users_stakeholders: Clinicians, patients, interpreters, privacy office, IT, medical records staff
adoption_posture: Conservative and risk-averse; follows validated peers
capabilities_constraints: Limited IT staff and training time; mixed mobile devices; EHR integration and vendor privacy review are unresolved; multilingual visits are common
risk_consequence_context: Incorrect or incomplete notes, privacy loss, consent failure, and inequitable performance could affect care and trust; clinician retains sign-off authority
management_question: When should the network start evaluating a bounded ambient-scribe pilot, rather than decide whether to buy or deploy system-wide?
